name: Adaptive Hierarchical Splatting with View-Dependent LOD
definition: A rendering method for non-uniform volumetric data that uses a hierarchical structure (octree or adaptive tree) to select levels of detail (LOD) based on a screen-space error metric, allowing for interactive navigation and progressive refinement.
summary: Adaptive Hierarchical Splatting with View-Dependent LOD is a rendering method for non-uniform volumetric data that uses a hierarchical structure to select levels of detail based on screen-space error, distinguishing itself by using a fixed linear footprint for culling and non-uniform elliptical splats for leaf nodes.
